usageNotes: Use this to permanently revoke an API token from a user account — for example, when rotating credentials, offboarding a user, or retiring an automation. The caller must either be the token's owner or hold User.Modify on the relevant user group. Deletion is immediate and irreversible; any service using the revoked token will lose API access instantly.

examples.summary: Revoke the 'automation' token for a local admin user

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the API token secret; the token cannot be recovered and any service or script using it will immediately lose API access.
tips: Token IDs must start with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters, dots, hyphens, or underscores.
Audit active tokens with get_access_users_userid_token_tokenid or list_access_users_userid_tokens before deleting to confirm which services depend on the token.
If rotating rather than permanently revoking, create the replacement token first so dependent services have zero-downtime transition.
